title: Dashboard Scope
text: Trace signals on scope display during simulation, {Legend} sets Legend position; {Connection} sets the signals to connect and display signal connection, {Line Style} sets the line style and color for connected signals line style and color, {Time Span} sets the time axis span, {Update Mode} displays update behavior, {Min} sets the vertical axis minimum, {Max} sets the vertical axis maximum, {Normalize y-axis limits} sets the option to normalize y -axis, {Scale axes limits at stop} sets the option to perform fit-to-view upon simulation, {Show "Double-click to connect" message} sets the connection instructions visibility, {Ticks} sets the axes tick positions, {Tick Labels} sets the tick label visibility, {Horizontal}, {Vertical}, {Border} plots border visibility, {Markers} sets the option to show signal data markers, {Foreground Color} sets the grid lines color, {Background Color} plots area color and {Font Color} sets the ticks and tick labels color. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Connection
params.values: Signals to connect and display signal connection options

params.name: Line Style
params.values: Line style and color for connected signals line style and color options

params.name: Normalize y-axis limits
params.values: Option to normalize y -axis off (default) | on

params.name: Scale axes limits at stop
params.values: Option to perform fit-to-view upon simulation stop on (default) | off

params.name: Ticks
params.values: Axes tick positions Outside (default) | Inside | None
